alternative.meaning: The existing Light appearance control on the fixture concept, not a fourth concept or a final look-selection result. Exercise from the opposite actual appearance so an unchanged selection cannot count as a response.

1 / Bench checklist · Purpose

Ada Mensah. Firmware at the bench.

How do you connect firmware to a physical observation?

For Mosslink, I wrote the firmware, scheduled the power states and built the bring-up fixture. Bring-up means checking a new board’s basic operation.

Six contact modules form an explanatory fixture. This geometry shows relationships, not actual wiring or the real device.

Email Ada · Read the conclusion

2 / Bench checklist · Observe

A command needs an observation.

A current trace showed the radio remaining awake after a failed transmission. The cause, fix and later outcome are not confirmed. The fixture opens here to separate code, access and observation.

Six contact modules form an explanatory fixture. This geometry shows relationships, not actual wiring or the real device.

3 / Bench checklist · Claim

A claim needs its limits.

Two years is a projection from bench current readings and an assumed reporting cycle. The longest observed run was 72 hours. An estimate and an observed run support different claims.

Six contact modules form an explanatory fixture. This geometry shows relationships, not actual wiring or the real device.
